messages:
julia_w: Hey - emergency room visit on 2026-05-28 while traveling. I lost my insurance card and the hospital billed me as self-pay. I paid $390. Carrier now shows denial: 'member not found'. Any easy path to reimbursement?

sam_peopleops: Oh no @julia_w. Which Redwood plan are you on (PPO/HMO)? If PPO usually can submit a member claim or ask hospital to re-bill with member ID.

julia_w: Redwood Standard PPO. I have the paid receipt and the hospital registration form but no physical card. The ER said they scanned something wrong.

denise_benefits: Steps that usually work: 1) Get digital ID (carrier portal > ID cards > download PDF). 2) Ask hospital billing to re-file claim with the member ID (they often need a signed authorization). 3) If they won't re-file, submit an OON claim yourself with itemized receipt + proof of payment + short cover letter.

julia_w: Clinic billing said they can re-bill if I sign a form. Can People Ops provide a short authorization template I can sign and email them? Also how long to get a digital card?

sam_peopleops: Yup, DM me and I'll send the authorization template and request a PDF card from the carrier. Carriers can often push a digital card PDF within 24-48 hrs if HR records confirm enrollment.

harry_finance: If you need money faster, Finance can issue a one-off advance after you upload the receipt to Expensify with tag "health-advance". We'll reconcile if carrier later reimburses. Typical review 1-3 business days.

denise_benefits: I'll paste a quick authorization below you can sign and send to hospital: 

"Authorization to Update Billing/Resubmit Claim"
Patient: Julia W.
Member ID: XXXXXX1234
DOB: 1990-04-11
I authorize [Hospital Name] to correct my member information and resubmit the claim for services on 2026-05-28 to [Carrier]. Signature: __________ Date: _____

claims_bot: [automated] Carrier tip: For emergency services, include clinical notes and itemized ER bill when requesting reprocessing. Appeals/reprocessing can take 7-45 days. Collections holds can be requested if documentation is submitted. Link: https://carrier.example/appeals

julia_w: Thanks all. I'll DM the signed authorization to the hospital and upload the receipt to Expensify in case I need an advance. Will update here once hospital re-bills or carrier replies.
